svg.title: Text-to-SQL Interface with Guardrails and Hallucination Detection architecture
svg.desc: System architecture showing an analyst, synthetic data and semantic catalog, FastAPI proposal and approval interfaces, Azure OpenAI, SQLGlot and DuckDB validation, ephemeral approval storage, read-only execution, privacy boundary, telemetry, deployment controls, and evaluation.
